LanguageData.NR_BDNeedsDevice: needs braindance goggles or a cyberlink
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Noticed: Your intrusions are starting to be linked together.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Tracked: Someone is deliberately tracing the source of the signal.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_Target: Your colony is a known target. Expect an answer.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelDesc_RedZone: The whole network can see you.
LanguageData.NR_HeatLevelUp: Digital trace: {0}. The network is paying closer attention to your colony.
LanguageData.NR_AlertHeatDesc:
Your colony's digital trace is {0} out of 100 ({1}).

Every successful hack leaves a trace. Hackers with higher stealth leave less of it, and hacking from a cyberpod is quieter still.

The trace cools down by {2} per day on its own.

Levels: Shadow 0–24, Noticed 25–49, Tracked 50–74, Target 75–94, Red Zone 95–100.
LanguageData.NR_CommandNetTerminalDesc: Open the network terminal: your digital trace, fixers, contracts and the journal of recent events.
LanguageData.NR_CyberpodBonusData: {0} pulled an extra cyberdata through the cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsDiveReportTip: After leaving a dive, open a window with the haul, costs, Heat and Netsick.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsNewcomer: Network events only after the colony goes online
LanguageData.NR_SettingsNewcomerTip: Netrun threats (net attacks, corporate hunts, mercenaries, AI and fixer events) wait until the colony has touched the net: any Heat, a cyberpod, console or AI server built, a colonist with a cyberlink, or a dive. Black market and distress signal come anyway.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsDifficultyTip: A preset for how fast Heat grows, how fast it cools and how much a fixer scrubs. Fine-tune under "Advanced".
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqAttacksTip: Net attacks, mercenary raids and the corporate hunt.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqMapTip: Data courier, black market, distress signal, turret hijack.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFreqCyberTip: ICE hunter, rival netrunners, honeypots, data storms, wild AIs.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAIEventFrequencyTip: AI events: requests, favors and tricks of your AIs.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsPauseTip: The game pauses once when the terminal opens; you can unpause it while it is open.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsAnimationsTip: Floating Gateway nodes and glowing Core nodes. Turn off if the terminal feels slow.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsReportInfoDesc: Found a bug? Copy the info below and paste it into the bug report on GitHub with your Player.log.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsReportInfo: Copy info for a bug report
LanguageData.NR_SettingsUnlockHelpTip: Unlocks the spoiler articles (boss node, hacker group…) in this game.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFont: Terminal font: Tektur (off: the standard font)
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFontTip: The mod's windows use the Tektur font (SIL Open Font License). Turn off to use the game's font.
LanguageData.NR_SettingsFontMissing: Terminal font: the Tektur bundle was not found, the standard font is used.
